run_pip_init_install: run pip_init.py to install specified pip packages with version pinning for linting tools
run_pip_init_dry_run: run pip_init.py with --dry-run 1 to preview package installation without executing
run_pip_init_verbose: run pip_init.py with --verbose to get detailed logging output during package installation
run_command_subprocess: run a subprocess command with timing and debug logging via the run_command helper function
install_linter_packages: install linter packages using pip_init.py with versioned package arguments like flake8==5.0.4
